agent_notes: Bundelkhand University is confirmed in all seven supplied NIRF 2025 category listings, with the official campus address in Jhansi.

Normal TLS verification initially failed with curl error 60, self signed certificate in certificate chain, from the managed network proxy. After confirming the expected public hosts, public GET requests used curl --insecure only; no credentials or private data were sent.

The official catalogue is not one complete canonical catalogue: the 2026-27 Academic Bulletin lists 116 programme rows, while separate current FYUP pages list additional programmes and the syllabus page contains overlapping or ambiguous labels such as Fine Arts all courses and generic M.Sc.

The admissions page advertises a Ph.D. admission portal and notices but does not publish a discipline-level doctoral programme catalogue. Campus versus affiliated-college scope also cannot be reconciled safely from the available pages.

Because the active programme catalogue is incomplete and internally inconsistent, no course records were imported and manual review is required. The career tree was inspected read-only from assets/data/career_path.db; it was not modified.
